content: ¿Zuwanllee, tamarimsa; taaris? Nuw Sandeeki siyaam kirakaa yandakina. Nuw uru Isustana wámachtashina. Apanlleem ashiritamina. Watam Ísúkirísut iycha kurakarini. Na kirak siyaam yandayaruri, zanganchintspa. Siy nish Utaásh tsapurunas pseertarus, tunarip naatambarangis arapi anoomis, siyaam yandaktana. Siyaam Akoparinchicheemis yandakina.
Ashiriya, zuwanllee, Sambaytarintspa; Apanllee izuuru mangoonangtsa, nuw siyaa atashina

Uru nee yasaktischa, ashiritaa yusur mangeetsis p'tsichintspa. Iy Apanllimun mangini tatkuni, anumand Yashing' iyaa kiyung yachaku, urutari nda achim tamundakiya. Ashkachinaari itaru siy Apanllimun kuk kizpurtayarus, patsisayarus, itamsayarus, kasikchus, ashiri aranginasha Apanllee mangoonatssa; Apanllimun kizpursha taatssa. Ashiriya, Yashing' kiyung yachakinaari, mangis mantsarintspa, atina siyaatsi.

Yashingoo itamsamaam mangeemis p'tseeshish pishtakinaari, Apanllee mashangtsa. Apaa, wizpurirish panangandama; mangeetsi p'tseengandama, tángtsa. Ashiri tákchus, Apanllsha kis istachintsa. Uru kis istatariya. ¿Antaati Isus: Mayaama mashaksha; átareeja? nda. Kis istachintsa.
Itaru, mashkus, Apanllimun mangis tateerus, mashangtsa. ¿Kamapa istaku istachiya? tárintspa. Atinaareesa ashiru, waras tamapari ashirupa taatssa.

Napancha: pakich kambustakachu, warasa winda winda zaw zaw ashtariya. Ashkitamsa, piyari chinakus. Mishat, kambusur pakich kambustakachu, iwaziri zapan warastakiya. Siy ashkitamsa iwaziri tsiyatkus. ¿Tamaree ashkinaaris, Apanll istaku istachints? Istacheeja, ndambaree. Ashiri Apanllee mangiptis mashangtsa tina.
Siy na pukiritaateesa taakus, mangis mantsarintspa. Apanllsha siyaa kizpur istakchu, anumunsha mangis kisshapa taatssa.

Siy ashpatamtis kurkirtaateesa taakus, ashiritaa kurikirimunis mangis tatintspa; mapiyngtsa, watam natumasamaam payuksawa. Itaru, Apanllimun mangis tatkinaareesa, siy kurikireetsis kanatsipkitaateesa, ashiritaa mangis kis taatssa. Watam maachiritis manginshuch chap tamapari ashiru mikeeru kuchakuwa.
Napancha: kizpur zar zatkachu, chirichir nda yutarit mawirukiya. Mawiruyaru, kuruskiya. Sheeru napamaam wanasireeja.
Siy ashkitamta maachiritis. Yusur kurikee arangeem putamaam zandkitaateesa, ashiritaa uru maachiritis kuchakuchtachiya. Ashiri kurikee chinarintspa, nuw siyaa atashina.

Kiyung kachiykus, Yashing' siyaa kapung tamundakinaari, itaru kizpurtakchus, mangis kis taachpasa. Apanll ateeja; Tputs nuwaa chinaku, anoom nuwsha taarashish panachima; atiya. Ashiri, siyaa yashing' tamundakinaari, itaru siy Apanllee uru chinakus, nda kasakus, Apanllsha siyaam taarashish panachparee.
Itaru, siyaa yashing' tamundaku anoo: ¿Mayaama Apanll nuwaa ashkanda? tárintspa. ¿Antaati Apanll yutaritshishee ashimaam yasareeja? Ashirucha, Apanll chiyaa yutaritam ínamaam pinasakitamta.
Itaru, chiy ngutich yutaritshishee támarakuch, anoo chinachinaw ashkuch, mangishich payutarchi.
Ashkachinaareechi, kapung yutarit taakuch, tsipachpachi; Yashingushshapa taachchi.
Ashiri Apanllee yutaritam ínakus, saantari ngutis ngichintspa, zuwanllee. Yashing' siyaa kasiyantspa tina.

Itaru, Apanll chiyaa yutaritam ínamaam wanindaja; chiyaa wanasiri istakiya. Apanllimari iyaam taarasheemani wanasirimash istakiya. Nllitaritamashee istamaam wanindaja. Apanll k'kuzee tsimbun payukeeja; minamaricha payuksha. Mangush nllitari chinatareeja.
¿Tamaru zaree, misha tsangachee tinaranga Apanlli? Tunimaa nda pakchiyam chinatariya. Ashirucha, Apanll iyaam taarasheemani ashirangtamta.

Apanll waana zandarangu, iyaa tiptsireem ínarangiya. Waanamuntari kuk zurumapanimun iyaam taarasheemani kaneesich istarangiya nda yutarit taamaama. Ashirucha, Apanll maacheetsi ichinguru wanasirimsheetstaa tinarangu, ashiri iyaatssha yutaritshishirini tachingeeru, iyaam kasirinasha wanasiri tinarangiya Apanlli. Ashiri yuwaa iy Apanllee izuuru mangoonkini anoo kamaneena.
Mazinangantsa zuwanllee; siyaa Apanllee kuk payumaam wanichintspa
Zuwanllee, nuwaa kuki kaapa mazinangtsa. Apanllee kuk ichtaru kaapa mazinangimasints. Musá tsiyantintspa. Apingsari tsiyatangtsa.
Tputs tsiyantaku, uru Apanllee wanasirimshirini pataxtariya.

Ashiriya, yutaritshishee izuuru ksangtsa. Piyari chinarintspa atina. Itaru, Apanllee kuk izuuru payungtsa. Watam Apanll waanaatsi kuk panaranguwa iyaam tapachindamaama. Ashiri nda tsiyantamaam, Apanllee kuk mazinangimasints; ngatintspa atina siyaatsi.
Saantari ngichintspa, zuwanllee. Iwaziri Apanllee kuk mangoonintspa; izuuru mangoonangtsa.
Itaru, chiy ngutaritich: Apanllee kuk mangoonaktana; átuch, itaru nda izuuru payukuch, musásiri mbizakchi. Ispingush napkuch tamatarpachi ashiritam taakchi.
Tputs ispingush waanaatsi wanee napanaptarangu, musásiri kasata sheeru, musásiritam mbizakiya yuwaa wanee parangu anootsi. Chiy ashkitamta Apanllee kuk nda mangoonkuch.

Itaru, kaapa mangoonkuch, nda ashtarchi. Isusoo kuk mazinayaruch, nda mbizakuch, kaapa mangoonakchi. Apanll kuk chiyaa Yashingoo tatutskiya. Ashirucha, izuuru payukchuch, nda kasakuch, kisshapa taachchi atashina.

Itaru, tputs nda mangpatari: Apanllee mangoonaktana átu, Apanllee mangu ngichkiya. Mang' nda itsinsaru chinaku, tamasingsingtar ashku, mantsir tsiyatku, an tputs Apanllee ngichkiya; mangutari: Apanllee mangoonaktana atiya. Waanaatstamari ungirtaku mangu atiya.

Itaru,: Apanllee izuuru mangoonaktana átu, wanasiritam taachiya. Yutaritshishirini ndunichiya. Apanll kis ashimaa napkiya. Anumash tputs uru mxaxzee istatariya. Mashindoo istataritamcha; watam kiyung kachiykanawa. Yuw tputs Apanllee kuk izuuru payuku an waanaatsi mang' taminllurtatareeja, dancha. Ashirucha, Apanllee kuk zurampatari chinangtsa atashina siyaatsi.

footnotes.text: Salmo 37.2, misha Isáysa 40.6-8 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
